model: add Kimi-K3.1-Pro text model (#31779)

* model: add Kimi-K3.1-Pro text model

K3 with the full-attention MLA layers replaced by DSA: on this checkpoint 24
of the 93 layers carry a lightning indexer (32 heads x 128, top_k 2048, no
rope). The KDA (linear-attention) layers and the rest of the K3 skeleton -
cross-layer residuals, latent MoE, situ, MLA output gate, full-rank KDA gate -
are unchanged, so this reuses the K3 graph and converter and adds the indexer.

Indexer:
  - the selection is an additive mask over the whole cache, not a gather of
    the top-k rows, so it reuses the existing sparse flash attention path;
    off that path the mask stays correct but still costs a kq over the cache
  - the indexer key LayerNorm takes its eps from the model's rms_norm_eps,
    because dsa_config declares no eps of its own

Graph and cache:
  - new arch with four indexer tensors per DSA layer, and a hybrid memory
    that keeps a K-only MLA cache for those layers, recurrent state for the
    KDA layers, and the indexer key cache
  - the graph node budget shares the K3 entry

Conversion:
  - KimiK31Model(KimiK3Model), picked by KimiK31ForConditionalGeneration
  - dsa_config becomes attention.indexer.{head_count,key_length,top_k,types}
    plus the indexer LayerNorm eps; the layer list is 1-indexed like
    linear_attn_config's, and the converter asserts that it covers exactly
    the full-attention layers
  - the routed experts stay MXFP4 and are repacked as in K3, not dequantized
  - the vision tower and mm_projector are skipped: text only for now
  - the arch key follows the checkpoint's own model_type ("kimi_k31") and the
    loader registers KimiK31ForConditionalGeneration; the release name carries
    a -Pro suffix that nothing in the config or the ten

hexagon: conv_2d optimizations and support for conv_3d (#31814)

* hexagon: Generalization of CONV_2D implementation for CONV_3D

- New op HTP_OP_CONV_3D is wired through htp-ops.h, main.c (shares op_conv_2d) and the op remap in htp-kparams.cpp.
- conv_3d runs on the existing HMX tiled (implicit GEMM) conv2d path. KD and KH are folded into one virtual kernel row (KD*KH), and output rows are counted as N*OD*OH.
- htp_kparams_solve_conv3d checks the conv_3d layout and calls the tiled solver htp_kparams_conv2d_tiled, which takes an is3d flag.
- The tiled kernel takes the sizes and strides that differ between conv_2d and conv_3d from a struct htp_conv_geom. Only the input stage unfolds depth.
- 256-entry DMA queue can no longer overflow

Assisted-by: Claude Code

* hexagon: modify checking to eliminate divide-by-zero hazards

* hexagon: conv2d tiled: compute the conv_3d unfold divisors on the host

The KH and OH fastdiv values used to unfold conv_3d kh into (kd, kh) and
oh into (od, oh) were built per op on the device, each with a 64-bit
divide. Pass them in the kernel params instead; they fit in the space the
window variant already reserves, so the struct size does not change.

Assisted-by: Claude Code

* hexagon : preserve fold scheduling in conv2d for small size

hexagon : support arbitrary positive conv2d strides
Support positive horizontal strides for WHCN and CWHN inputs. Preserve
load/shuffle paths for strides 1/2 and use gather for larger strides.

hexagon : improve conv2d tile size selection

Prefer the largest feasible output-channel block and derive spatial
chunk capacity from VTCM usage. Compare capacity and thread-aligned
candidates using per-thread work and chunk overhead.

Co-authored-by: Yiwei Shao <yiwei@aizip.ai>

* hex-conv: fix compiler w
